title: Marvel Ballooning
specs: Flights over a mix of urban and rural landscapes with diverse wildlife
Chief Pilot Joe Burger has over 19 years flying experience and 7,000+ hours in 18 aircraft types
No age or height restrictions; passengers must be able to stand and hold on under their own power
Weight limit per passenger is 250 pounds; heavier passengers may need to purchase a second fare
Passengers must be able to get in basket with minimal assistance and stand for duration
Pregnant women should consult physician before participating
Shared flights with other passengers; private flights available by arrangement
Tethered balloon events can accommodate up to about 60 people per hour
